**alibabacloud-analyticdb-mysql-copilot v0.0.2 changelog**

- English localization: All skill descriptions, rules, and references updated from Chinese to English for wider accessibility.
- Enhanced CLI requirements: Minimum aliyun-cli version raised to 3.3.3; now mandates plugin auto-installation and regular updates.
- Strict AI-mode management: Enforced enable/disable workflow for AI-mode at every entry and exit point (new mandatory procedure).
- User-Agent enforcement: Every CLI command now explicitly includes a standard user-agent for traceability.
- Improved cluster & region validation: Added explicit option-card based user confirmations for region and cluster selections; region routing rules strictly implemented.
- Major structure update: Skill logic and procedure guidance reworked; added and removed references for diagnosis workflows.
